newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Rep. Torres being considered for cabinet post.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Rep. Torres being considered for cabinet post.

text.p: A spokesman for U.S. Congressman Esteban Torres said Tuesday the Democrat from California was being considered by President Clinton for a Cabinet post.
However, the spokesman declined to comment on speculation that the posts were either Labor or Housing Secretary. "There's no confirmation on either at this point," the spokesman for Torres said.

Earlier Tuesday, White House spokesman Mike McCurry was asked whether Clinton had interviewed Torres for a cabinet post. "I'm not going to speculate about who had been interviewed. I think he's a highly regarded individual. I don't know ... whether he's under any formal consideration. I decline to say."
Labor Secretary Robert Reich and Housing Secretary Henry Cisneros both have said they will not be part of Clinton's Cabinet during his second presidential term.
Torres, 66, was an assembly line welder in Los Angeles during the 1950s and was active in the United Auto Workers union.
Torres was also a former ambassador to the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO).
